marta: FYI I'm hitting a weird combination of ESM/CJS conditional-exports + bundler behavior that breaks our JS SDK in an edge sample app.

marta: Repro (very small):
1) clone our sampleapp (edge-ssr-vite)
2) yarn && yarn build && yarn start-edge
3) trigger /api/generate which calls new RedwoodSDK({ auth: process.env.RW_KEY }) from the bundled server build

marta: Error I see on the edge runtime: `TypeError: RedwoodSDK.default is not a constructor` (or sometimes `RedwoodSDK is undefined`). Happens only on production build with Vite/Rollup targeting edge. Dev build (vite dev) is fine.

akshay: hmm. conditional exports maybe? package.json has `exports: {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}` so bundlers pick import path, but our build step also ships a `module.exports` shim for cjs consumers. Could be a default vs named export mismatch after bundler + esbuild transform.

jamie: Can you paste the top of the built bundle where the SDK is imported? e.g. the snippet in server-dist/entry.js where it does `const RedwoodSDK = require('redwood-sdk')` vs `import RedwoodSDK from 'redwood-sdk'`.

marta: snippet from the SSR bundle: ```
var redwood_sdk = __toCommonJS(require('redwood-sdk'))
const sdk = new redwood_sdk(); // blown up here
```

marta: Also noticed that when I add `import * as RedwoodSDK from 'redwood-sdk'` the error changes to `TypeError: RedwoodSDK.Client is not a constructor` so it's definitely an interop/exports shape problem.

tasha: Do you see this across all bundlers? vite only? rollup only? webpack?

marta: Reproduced on Vite (ssr build), Rollup (manual), Webpack 5 (target: webworker/edge) — all produce slightly different shapes but same root cause: the edge runtime ends up with wrong export shape.

noah: Another wrinkle: when running on our actual edge runtime (CloudEdge), the auth header seems to get stripped on retried requests from the SDK. I dug into logs and saw initial request has Authorization, retry attempt doesn't. Suspect our SDK's retry wrapper re-creates Request without headers in some environments (fetch polyfill differences).

akshay: That matches a known pattern: if retry logic does `fetch(req)` but clones or serializes and re-creates `new Request(req.url, { method: req.method })` it can lose headers/body if not copied. Edge runtimes and some bundlers change the Request prototype shape so `instanceof Request` checks fail, causing fallback code to run.

devx-bot: CI build passed on node target, failed on edge-target CI job (ssr-edge). See job 4523 logs: https://ci/internal/jobs/4523

jamie: For repro, can you try forcing the import path to the ESM entry directly in sample app to confirm? e.g.:
```js
// temp repro in sampleapp/src/server.js
import SDK from 'redwood-sdk/dist/esm/index.js'
const sdk = new SDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```
If that fixes it, it's definitely conditional exports resolution issue.

marta: did that — pointing to dist/esm/index.js changes the error to decorators/kv-cache missing (weird), so the ESM build works but some transitive import expects `globalThis.fetch` polyfill to be present and our bundler strips it.

tasha: Another common gotcha: some bundlers rewrite `exports` or use `module.exports =` interop helpers which add a `.default` wrapper. Edge runtimes that use ESM-only loader treat the shim differently. Workaround is to ensure SDK ships a single ESM entry and consumers import the ESM build, or provide a tiny interop shim: `module.exports = require('./dist/esm/index.js').default || require('./dist/esm/index.js')`.

noah: About the auth header loss on retry — can you paste the retry wrapper in the SDK?

marta: here's the relevant portion from node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/esm/fetch-retry.js (minified but reformat):
```js
export async function sendWithRetry(originalReq) {
  try {
    return await fetch(originalReq)
  } catch (err) {
    // naive re-create:
    const r = new Request(originalReq.url, { method: originalReq.method })
    return await fetch(r)
  }
}
```
This loses headers/body. In dev node this code path is rare because node fetch clones differently. In edge the first fetch often fails (timeout) and retry loses Authorization.

akshay: Ok we should: 1) fix retry logic to clone headers/body properly; 2) add tests for edge-friendly Request cloning; 3) fix packaging so ESM path is unambiguous for bundlers.

jamie: For quick reproduction steps that anyone can run locally:
1) git clone repo sampleapp-edge-bundler-repro
2) cp .env.example .env (set RW_KEY)
3) yarn && yarn build:ssr:edge (this runs vite build --ssr --target=webworker)
4) node ./edge-simulate.js --load-bundle ./dist/server-edge.js (we have a tiny worker shim to run in node)
Trigger POST /api/generate with curl and inspect logs.

marta: I added a minimal repro in the sampleapp under `repros/conditional-exports-edge/` with full steps + a tiny fixture that runs the exact bundlers (vite/rollup/webpack) and collects the exported shape for the SDK. See repro README in that folder.

tasha: Thanks. Can you open a small PR with: a) fix to retry (clone headers/body), b) update packaging to include `exports.browser` pointing to ESM as well, and c) a test under `integration/edge` that runs the worker shim? We'll land fast.

marta: will do the PR. One more odd thing: webpack build only fails when `optimization.moduleIds = 'named'` is on; with `deterministic` it works. So webpack optimization heuristics interact with our AMD/cjs interop helper. Might be worth adding a note in sampleapp README for bundler config quirks.

noah: I'll also add an e2e job in CI to run the `repros/conditional-exports-edge` bundle matrix on vite/rollup/webpack so we don't regress.

akshay: I'll draft the SDK changes (retry clone + test) and ping for review. Thanks for the reproducible steps + bundle snippets — super helpful. :raised_hands:

marta: thanks all — PR incoming in ~30m. If reviewers want to try locally earlier point at branch `marta/repro-bundler-edge`.

devx-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/redwood/sdk/pulls/1234 (wip)

jamie: Nice. After the fix let's also add a tiny docs note in devx docs about bundler conditional exports and edge runtimes (common traps).

marta: added that to the PR description.

noah: assigning ops ticket to add CI matrix: OPS-827

akshay: Will add changelog entry and release note about improved edge retry behavior.

marta: closing loop here — thanks everyone, will update thread after CI runs.
